references.text: The same offering was given by Nahshon son of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah—the silver plate, the silver bowl, and fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering. This shows the recurring pattern of identical gifts from each tribal leader.
Netanel's offering from the tribe of Issachar contained the same elements—a silver plate, a silver bowl, and fine flour mixed with oil.
Eliab's offering from the tribe of Zebulun included identical silver vessels and a grain offering.
The shekel of the sanctuary is mentioned as the standard weight, the same unit used to measure the silver objects.
The regulation for the grain offering (mincha) of fine flour mixed with oil, which is the same as described in this verse.
Plates and bowls made of pure gold were crafted for the tabernacle, similar vessels to the silver plates and silver bowls that the tribal leaders offered.
